title.en: Collocations: make, do, take, have; idioms

rule.sl:
**make**, kar nastane: **a decision** (britansko tudi **take a decision**), **a mistake**, **a noise**, **a phone call**, **friends**, **an effort**, **the bed**.

**do**, delo in opravila: **the washing up**, **the shopping**, **the cooking**, **your homework**, **your best**, **a favour**, **business**.

**take**: **a photo**, **a seat**, **the bus**, **your time**, **care**, **a break**, **an exam** (britansko tudi **sit an exam**).

**have**: **a chat**, **a rest**, **a look**, **a go**, **a good time**, **a party**, **lunch**, **a shower**, **a bath**. Mnogo gre tudi s **take**: **take a shower**, **take a look**.

Pridevnik + samostalnik: **heavy rain**, **heavy traffic**, **strong tea**, **strong wind**, **thick fog**, **light rain**, **a close friend**, **a bad cold**.

Frazemi: **It's raining cats and dogs** (lije kot iz škafa), **a piece of cake** (mala malica), **under the weather** (ni mi dobro), **over the moon** (v sedmih nebesih), **a storm in a teacup** (vihar v kozarcu vode), **once in a blue moon** (enkrat na sto let). Spreminja se le glagol.
rule.de:
**make**, was entsteht: **a decision** (britisch auch **take a decision**), **a mistake**, **a noise**, **a phone call**, **friends**, **an effort**, **the bed**.

**do**, Arbeit und Aufgaben: **the washing up**, **the shopping**, **the cooking**, **your homework**, **your best**, **a favour**, **business**.

**take**: **a photo**, **a seat**, **the bus**, **your time**, **care**, **a break**, **an exam** (britisch auch **sit an exam**).

**have**: **a chat**, **a rest**, **a look**, **a go**, **a good time**, **a party**, **lunch**, **a shower**, **a bath**. Vieles geht auch mit **take**: **take a shower**, **take a look**.

Adjektiv + Nomen: **heavy rain**, **heavy traffic**, **strong tea**, **strong wind**, **thick fog**, **light rain**, **a close friend**, **a bad cold**.

Redewendungen: **It's raining cats and dogs** (es schüttet), **a piece of cake** (ein Kinderspiel), **under the weather** (nicht ganz gesund), **over the moon** (im siebten Himmel), **a storm in a teacup** (ein Sturm im Wasserglas), **once in a blue moon** (alle heiligen Zeiten). Nur das Verb ändert sich.
rule.it:
**make**, ciò che nasce: **a decision** (in britannico anche **take a decision**), **a mistake**, **a noise**, **a phone call**, **friends**, **an effort**, **the bed**.

**do**, lavori e faccende: **the washing up**, **the shopping**, **the cooking**, **your homework**, **your best**, **a favour**, **business**.

**take**: **a photo**, **a seat**, **the bus**, **your time**, **care**, **a break**, **an exam** (in britannico anche **sit an exam**).

**have**: **a chat**, **a rest**, **a look**, **a go**, **a good time**, **a party**, **lunch**, **a shower**, **a bath**. Molti vanno anche con **take**: **take a shower**, **take a look**.

Aggettivo + nome: **heavy rain**, **heavy traffic**, **strong tea**, **strong wind**, **thick fog**, **light rain**, **a close friend**, **a bad cold**.

Modi di dire: **It's raining cats and dogs** (piove a catinelle), **a piece of cake** (una passeggiata), **under the weather** (non sto bene), **over the moon** (al settimo cielo), **a storm in a teacup** (una tempesta in un bicchier d'acqua), **once in a blue moon** (ogni morte di papa). Cambia solo il verbo.
rule.en:
**make**, what comes to be: **a decision** (British **take a decision** too), **a mistake**, **a noise**, **a phone call**, **friends**, **an effort**, **the bed**.

**do**, work and jobs: **the washing up**, **the shopping**, **the cooking**, **your homework**, **your best**, **a favour**, **business**.

**take**: **a photo**, **a seat**, **the bus**, **your time**, **care**, **a break**, **an exam** (British **sit an exam** too).

**have**: **a chat**, **a rest**, **a look**, **a go**, **a good time**, **a party**, **lunch**, **a shower**, **a bath**. Many go with **take** too: **take a shower**, **take a look**.

An adjective + a noun: **heavy rain**, **heavy traffic**, **strong tea**, **strong wind**, **thick fog**, **light rain**, **a close friend**, **a bad cold**.

Idioms: **It's raining cats and dogs** (it's raining hard), **a piece of cake** (very easy), **under the weather** (not very well), **over the moon** (very happy), **a storm in a teacup** (a fuss about little), **once in a blue moon** (very rarely). Only the verb changes.
